label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: A Dios no maldecirás, y a príncipe en tu pueblo no maldecirás.
spanish: A Dios no injuriarás, y a príncipe en tu pueblo no maldecirás.

units.es: y a príncipe en tu pueblo no maldecirás

grammarChanges: Changed the first clause's verb from maldecirás to injuriarás so H7043 piel (qalal: revile / treat with contempt) and H779 qal (arar: curse) are no longer rendered with the same Spanish verb; the second clause keeps maldecirás for arar.
Kept personal a before Dios and príncipe; it is Spanish grammar required for a human direct object and does not correspond to a Hebrew preposition, so it was left unchanged.
readerNote: Chose injuriarás for the piel of qalal (revile/treat with contempt) and kept maldecirás for the qal of arar (curse) to preserve the lexical distinction the draft had collapsed into one verb.
